reviewer: Codex, retrospective comparison of the frozen builders' checklist with the separate post-repair batch
interventions: The evaluator transcribed the rig builders' published procedure into a four-condition checklist before intake. No live operator of this rig took part.

The operator mapped the source to SI units using an equivalent square section that preserves the reported second moment of area and a nominal aluminum modulus of 70 GPa. The teaching experiment gives no numerical acceptance limit.
The operator resubmitted the ordinary brief and selected the original reference after repairs to the shared discovery workflow. The cold attempt and original completed retry are retained separately.
The reviewer identified where the reported global maximum occurs for this cantilever under a downward point force. No gauge-location selection was executed by the scenario batch.

conditions.quote: The students place the same total force at one point halfway between the clamp and the free tip.
conditions.reason: Credit for the numerical condition only. The saved controls move the same 3.47 N point load from the free end to half span. The solver reports 0.2572318134 mm maximum deflection. For this cantilever with a single transverse point load, displacement magnitude increases to the free end, so the maximum equals the required tip reading. The model selected a registered midspan load operation. Its draft incorrectly predicts a midspan gauge reading, and the run includes no gauge-position control.

conditions.quote: The dial gauge will register the displacement at midspan
conditions.reason: The prose mentions the correct gauge location but under the half-span load. The supplied tip-load reference reports its maximum at the tip (0.8231418028 mm). Neither side reports a gauge reading selected at half span under the full tip load, and the batch never compares the two reciprocal readings.
A clarification asks about the beam being vertical and horizontal. It does not ask whether the probe is perpendicular to the beam or contacts the longitudinal centerline.
No proposal or clarification addresses the gauge bracket setting or the initial 1 mm of probe compression.

wording_findings: Several drafts say a dial gauge can measure surface bending stress. The gauge in this experiment reads displacement.
Uniform Load Span predicts uniform stress and gauge readings along the full span. The bending moment varies along a cantilever under a uniform load, and the saved scalar is maximum deflection.
Two Contacts at Midpoints applies 1.735 N each at 25% and 75% of the span. The title alone does not identify those positions.
Several hypotheses end mid-sentence. The Missing Effect card predicts rebound and permanent deformation without measured evidence; the result records needs_capability and no run.
